papers.title: Performance Assessment and Design for Univariate Alarm Systems Based on FAR, MAR, and AAD
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
papers.access_note: Author-hosted manuscript on the University of Alberta ECE domain; discovered and HTTP-validated on 2026-08-28.
papers.method_summary: Finite-state Markov expressions for false-alarm rate, missed-alarm rate, and average alarm delay, followed by alarm parameter design.

local_validation.scope: closed-form and invariant tests; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: FAR, MAR, and AAD jointly define alarm-system performance.

papers.title: Design of Delay Timers Based on Estimated Probability Mass Functions of Alarm Durations
papers.method_summary: Estimates duration PMFs from non-IID alarm data and uses them to design delay timers.

local_validation.scope: synthetic duration-tail recovery; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: Duration distributions provide a non-IID route to delay-timer design.

papers.title: Alarm Deadband Design Based on Maximum Amplitude Deviations and Bayesian Estimation
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
papers.method_summary: Uses alarm-duration/deviation geometry to decide whether deadband is appropriate and a Bayesian amplitude-tail estimate to choose its width.

local_validation.scope: equation and synthetic episode tests; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: Maximum alarm deviations determine the remaining false-alarm probability after a deadband is applied.

papers.title: Design of Alarm Trippoints for Univariate Analog Process Variables Based on Alarm Probability Plots
papers.method_summary: Quantizes a process variable into Markov states and uses transition probability/time statistics to select a trippoint.

local_validation.scope: state-quantization and Markov-statistic invariants; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: APP threshold selection combines transition probability with available transition time.

papers.title: Alarm Monitoring for Multivariate Processes Based on a Convex-Hull Normal Operating Zone
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
papers.method_summary: Represents non-Gaussian normal multivariate operation with a convex hull and detects points outside that zone.

local_validation.scope: convex membership and dynamic-bound tests; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: A convex-hull NOZ avoids a Gaussian ellipsoid assumption.

papers.title: Multivariate Alarm Monitoring for Non-Convex Normal Operating Zones Based on Search Cones
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
papers.method_summary: Partitions directional space into search cones and learns a radial boundary for a non-convex normal operating zone.

local_validation.scope: non-convex angular/radial membership test; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: A union of search cones can represent non-convex normal operating zones.

papers.title: Design of Multivariate Alarm Systems Based on Online Calculation of Variational Directions
papers.method_summary: Extracts adaptive time gradients online and compares the multivariate direction vector with permitted normal rules.

local_validation.scope: weighted-slope and unseen-direction invariants; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: Adaptive time scales reduce noise sensitivity in online variation-direction extraction.

papers.title: Multivariate Alarm Systems for Time-Varying Processes Using Bayesian Filters With Applications to Electrical Pumps
papers.method_summary: Tracks normal time-varying regression parameters with a Bayesian filter and freezes updates in statistically abnormal windows.

local_validation.scope: parameter tracking, alarm, and update-freeze invariants; not a paper-score reproduction

claims.statement: Freezing model updates in abnormal windows prevents a time-varying estimator from adapting to faults.

papers.title: Multivariate Process Monitoring for Safe Operation of Condensers in Thermal Power Plants Based on Normal Operating Zones
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
papers.method_summary: Combines a condenser pressure model with a four-variable search-cone operating zone and Bayesian uncertainty analysis.

local_validation.scope: physical self-consistency and residual/zone alarm invariants; Bayesian paper bounds and industrial score pending

claims.statement: Condenser pressure is modeled from steam flow and cooling-water inlet/outlet temperatures before NOZ monitoring.

papers.title: Detection of Cause-Effect Relations Based on Information Granulation and Transfer Entropy
papers.method_summary: Abstracts continuous time series into information granules before estimating transfer entropy for causal discovery.

local_validation.scope: information-granule/OPTICS/IGTE causal-chain tests; paper two-tank score pending

claims.statement: Information granulation is used before transfer-entropy estimation.
The method is evaluated on simulated and industrial-process examples.

papers.title: Cause-Effect Analysis of Industrial Alarm Variables Using Transfer Entropies
papers.method_summary: Uses OR-aggregated binary alarm histories, normalized TE, normalized direct TE, and Bernoulli surrogate significance tests.

local_validation.scope: synthetic delayed-chain NTE/NDTE and direct-edge tests; industrial score pending

claims.statement: NDTE conditions on intermediate alarm variables to distinguish direct from indirect causal links.

papers.title: A New Transfer Entropy Approach Based on Information Granulation and Clustering for Root Cause Analysis
papers.method_summary: Combines information granulation, clustering, second-order transfer entropy, and direct conditional transfer entropy.

local_validation.scope: synthetic continuous causal-chain test; paper two-tank and TEP scores pending

claims.statement: Second-order IGTE improves stability relative to first order while IGDTE prunes indirect paths.

papers.title: Root-Cause Analysis of Occurring Alarms in Thermal Power Plants Based on Bayesian Networks
papers.venue: International Journal of Electrical Power & Energy Systems
papers.method_summary: Recursively updates binary Bayesian-network probabilities and ranks known cause patterns plus an unknown-cause state.

local_validation.scope: known/unknown root convergence and update-rate equation tests; industrial score pending

claims.statement: The update rate is selected as 1-(0.5)^(1/m) to match an m-sample state-change rule.

papers.title: Analysis of Time-Varying Cause-Effect Relations Based on Qualitative Trends and Change Amplitudes
papers.method_summary: Segments the target with PLR, aligns causes by piecewise lag correlation, and assigns non-negative regression contribution factors.

local_validation.scope: PLR, delay recovery, and dominant-driver factor tests; industrial score pending

claims.statement: Non-negative regression factors quantify each aligned variable's share of the target amplitude change.

papers.title: Criteria and Algorithms for Online and Offline Detections of Industrial Alarm Floods
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology
papers.method_summary: Detects alarm floods using newly appearing alarm tags, with online and offline interval logic.

local_validation.scope: I1/I2/I3 inheritance, long-standing exclusion, and delay tests; industrial score pending

claims.statement: Newly appearing tags are more robust to chattering and standing alarms than raw event counts.

papers.title: A Local Alignment Approach to Similarity Analysis of Industrial Alarm Flood Sequences
papers.method_summary: Adapts local sequence alignment to compare industrial alarm flood episodes.

local_validation.scope: priority/time/seeded alignment invariants; industrial score pending

claims.statement: Local alignment permits partial matches between alarm sequences.

papers.title: Detection of Frequent Alarm Patterns in Industrial Alarm Floods Using Itemset Mining Methods
papers.method_summary: Mines closed frequent alarm itemsets with vertical transaction IDs, then compresses similar patterns by modified delta clustering and greedy cover.

local_validation.scope: closedness and representative-cover invariants; industrial 921-to-207 pattern score pending

claims.statement: Closed patterns preserve support information while representative delta clustering compresses redundant alarm sets.

papers.title: A Maximum-Entropy-Based Method for Alarm Flood Prediction
papers.method_summary: Uses characteristic functions and maximum-entropy constraints to predict the next alarm from historical floods.

local_validation.scope: log-linear probability normalization and dominant-next-alarm recovery; paper Monte Carlo score pending

claims.statement: The next-alarm distribution is obtained under maximum-entropy constraints.

papers.title: Convolutional Kernel-Based Classification of Industrial Alarm Floods
papers.method_summary: CASIM transforms alarm sequences with randomized convolutional kernels, pools the responses, and uses a ridge ensemble plus local outlier probability for open-set decisions.

local_validation.scope: paper equations/mechanics and synthetic invariants; official TEP score reproduction pending gated data and capsule

claims.statement: CASIM uses convolutional-kernel features for early alarm-flood classification.
Open-set evaluation includes nuisance alarms, order changes, and unseen flood classes.
The authors provide a Code Ocean reproduction capsule.

papers.title: Addressing Uncertainty in Online Alarm Flood Classification Using Conformal Prediction
papers.role: SOTA uncertainty-aware online alarm flood classification
papers.method_summary: ConE-AFC wraps online alarm-flood classifiers with conformal calibration and returns prediction sets at controlled error levels.

local_validation.scope: Eqs. 1-5, Algorithms 1-2, probability/distance and expanding-window invariants; official table reproduction pending capsule/data

claims.statement: Conformal prediction exposes uncertainty as label sets for expanding alarm-sequence prefixes.
The authors provide a versioned Code Ocean reproduction capsule.

papers.title: Predicting Uncertainty Reduction in Online Alarm Flood Classification
papers.method_summary: Predicts when additional alarm observations are expected to reduce classification uncertainty.

local_validation.scope: bifurcation targets, explicit leave-one-out jackknife+ intervals and delay-timer invariants; paper feature/table reproduction pending full text/data

claims.statement: Uncertainty-reduction prediction is coupled to online classification delay.

papers.title: Robustness Analysis of Industrial Alarm Flood Classification
papers.method_summary: Evaluates alarm-flood classification under realistic corruptions and motivates robustness-specific metrics.

local_validation.scope: isolated data-quality corruptions and reproducibility invariants; original ETFA dataset scores pending

claims.statement: Nominal classification accuracy is insufficient for corrupted alarm streams.

papers.title: AFC-RobustBench: A Robustness Benchmark for Alarm Flood Classification
papers.method_summary: Defines benchmark perturbations for missing, spurious, timing-shifted, and delayed alarm detections, including mixed corruption.

local_validation.scope: five corruption regimes, prefix/severity profiles, Monte-Carlo intervals and normalized robustness AUC; exact paper tables pending source PDF/data

claims.statement: Robust evaluation must report separate and mixed alarm corruption regimes.

papers.title: Data-Efficient Handling of Temporary Uncertainties in Online Alarm Flood Classification
papers.role: SOTA data-efficient uncertainty-aware online alarm flood classification
papers.method_summary: Combines fold-wise cross-conformal prediction with expanding alarm-flood classifiers and postprocesses erroneously empty prediction sets.

local_validation.scope: standard pooled cross-conformal p-values, probability/distance orientation, expanding windows and explicit empty-set policies; exact paper equations, dataset and tables pending full text

claims.statement: The method combines cross-conformal prediction with early alarm-flood classification to reduce calibration-data demand.
The paper introduces postprocessing for erroneously empty prediction sets.
The current local top-p-value repair is an explicit independent choice and not asserted to be the paper-exact rule.

papers.title: Online Alarm Flood Classification via Deterministic Fingerprinting with Combinatorial Hashing: A Robust and Scalable Framework
papers.role: SOTA deterministic and scalable online alarm flood classification
papers.method_summary: Builds Alarm Evolution Matrices from sliding activation rates, extracts local peaks, forms deterministic combinatorial temporal hashes, aggregates class-level consensus fingerprint profiles, and classifies streaming floods with variability-aware evidence.

local_validation.scope: AEM sliding rates, deterministic peaks/hashes, majority consensus profiles, variability and prefix classification invariants; paper equations/parameters/tables and TEP scores pending

claims.statement: The offline pipeline uses AEM, localized peaks, CTFH and category-wise consensus fingerprint profiles.
The evaluation uses TEP and missing, false, delayed and reordered alarm perturbations.
The local peak, SHA-256 truncation, time quantization and Jaccard rules are auditable independent choices until full-text equations are acquired.

papers.title: Real-Time Classification and Early Warning of Industrial Alarm Floods Using Modified TF-IDF Methods
papers.role: SOTA n-gram clustering, fault isolation and early alarm-flood warning
papers.method_summary: Uses position-weighted n-gram TF-IDF and spectral clustering for historical floods, kernel PCA for fault isolation, and a five-stage LSTM classifier with a calibrated risk threshold for online early warning.

local_validation.scope: position-aware n-gram vectors, unsupervised n selection, spectral clustering, kernel-PCA residuals, threshold calibration and trainable prefix LSTM invariants; paper equations/VAM data/tables pending

claims.statement: The method combines position-weighted modified TF-IDF n-grams with spectral clustering.
The online pipeline uses kernel PCA for fault isolation and LSTM for early classification.
The case study uses alarm logs from a VAM production simulator.
Local position decay, kernels, optimizer and network sizes remain independent choices until full-text acquisition.

papers.title: Online Alarm Flood Classification via Interpretable Template Extraction and Structured Convolutional Matching
papers.role: SOTA interpretable visual-template online alarm flood classification
papers.method_summary: Extends HDAP to a structured HDAM, aligns variable-duration historical floods through two-dimensional convolution, extracts category templates, and matches a dynamic online HDAM for early classification.

local_validation.scope: HDAM binning, exact shift recovery, variable-duration consensus extraction, category matching and prefix invariants; paper equations/parameters/tables and TEP scores pending

claims.statement: The method extends HDAP into a structured matrix representation for offline and online use.
Structured two-dimensional convolution aligns floods of different durations and extracts category templates.
A dynamic HDAM is matched against learned templates for online early classification on TEP.
Local normalized correlation and medoid-consensus construction are auditable independent choices until full-text acquisition.

papers.title: Early Classification of Industrial Alarm Floods Using a Hybrid Neural Network and Optimal Time-Encoded Histograms
papers.role: SOTA early alarm-flood classification without chattering preprocessing
papers.method_summary: Encodes variable-length raw alarm floods as exponentially attenuated fixed histograms, learns the attenuation by gradient optimization, compresses correlated alarms in an autoencoder latent space, and classifies with a modified Transformer using separate pretraining followed by joint fine-tuning.

local_validation.scope: exponential temporal weights, positive gradient-trained attenuation, autoencoder pretraining, Transformer pretraining, joint fine-tuning and prefix inference invariants; exact equations/hyperparameters/TEP split and score pending

claims.statement: The histogram combines alarm frequency with exponential temporal attenuation and optimizes the attenuation by gradients.
The hybrid independently trains an autoencoder and modified Transformer before joint fine-tuning.
The method operates without delay-timer chattering removal and is evaluated on TEP.
Local tokenization, Transformer modification, layer widths and loss weights remain independent choices until full-text acquisition.
